title: Trading human execution approval (Human-in-the-Loop receipt)
description: Separates AI/tool proposal from commander GO/NO_GO for Track A trading execution. Bulkhead: B-track artifacts are referenced only via proposal_ref + proposal_body_sha256.

track.description: Execution rail: only Track A may consume this receipt for live order scripts.

proposal_id.description: Stable id of the proposal row or queue entry this approval binds to.

proposal_ref.description: Optional pointer to the proposal artifact on disk (hash must still match proposal_body_sha256).

proposal_body_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the proposal file bytes exactly as approved.

valid_until_utc.description: GO is invalid after this instant (replay guard). NO_GO receipts may reuse a short window; still required for uniform validation.

approver_label.description: Non-secret handle (e.g. commander); omit or use hash if sensitive.

nonce.description: Optional single-use token; consumers may reject duplicate nonce in audit log.
